purpose: Teach: トースト/キャンドル/めんどくさい/しわ/拾う/ガラガラ/バンバン/ローマ字

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、本気で、絶対、トースト、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、毎朝、絶対、焼いてくれたわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran, you remember — back when we were young, I used to make toast every single morning. You do remember that, don't you?
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Voice settles into the memory like sinking into a familiar chair. Gentle questioning at the end, not doubting her but inviting her in. Breath carries the weight of years.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。結婚式の夜、本気で、絶対、キャンドル、絶対、灯した、絶対、わよね、あなた、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: I do. That night at our wedding — you lit all those candles. Do you remember, dear? You really did.
lines.style: Warm, present tense despite the decades. Each image crystalline. Voice tender but grounded, not drifting. A gentle affirmation, as if confirming something true between them both.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 近頃、本気で、絶対、めんどくさい、絶対、と、絶対、感じること、絶対、多くなったわよな、ばあさん
lines.en: Lately, though — seems like more and more things feel like too much bother, you know?
lines.style: Lighter, almost self-aware. A wry smile underneath. Not complaining exactly, more observing his own shift with gentle, tired humor. Shorter breath between thoughts.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんも、本気で、絶対、お顔に、絶対、しわ、絶対、増えたわよ、あなた、優しいしわよね
lines.en: Well, your face has picked up a few more lines too, dear. But they're kind lines.
lines.style: Not defensive. Matter-of-fact, almost playful. A soft turn of affection — noticing his change and refusing to let it be small. Warm without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、孫の手を、絶対、拾うかのように、絶対、お父さん、絶対、抱き上げたわよ、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Back then, I could pick up our boy like he was nothing — light as a grandchild's hand. You remember that, don't you?
lines.style: Wistful reach backward. Voice lengthens on the memory. A quiet wonder at his own younger strength. Asking not to be reassured but to be witnessed in remembering.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昔の駄菓子屋、本気で、絶対、ガラガラ、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、よく、絶対、引いたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Oh yes — the old candy shop. You used to pull that raffle wheel all the time. You remember that, don't you?
lines.style: Alive with the memory. Voice lifts slightly, animated but soft. Not performing excitement, just the genuine brightness of seeing something vividly. Breath carries delight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 夏祭りで、本気で、絶対、太鼓を、絶対、バンバン、絶対、叩いたわよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: And at the summer festival — bang, bang — you really beat that drum like you meant it. Don't you remember?
lines.style: Playful brightness emerges. Voice has energy, mimics the drumbeat's rhythm without overdoing it. A shared smile under the words. Inviting him to feel that younger vitality again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、若い頃、絶対、ローマ字、絶対、お手紙、絶対、書いてくれたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, you used to write me letters in Roman characters. Sweet letters. You do remember, don't you?
lines.style: Tender and present. Voice settles on the image like it's still there in her hands. Not wistful — something more: the quiet certainty of being truly seen and remembered. Gentle breath.
